note: Each prompt runs in a fresh session (claude -p, same model) in an empty dir holding a raw take (generate one: ffmpeg -f lavfi -i testsrc=s=1470x1580:d=70:r=30 -pix_fmt yuv420p raw.mp4) and the scenario's files. Control: --disable-slash-commands (no skills). Grade only from the files the run writes. Evidence: a real session making a square social video of a terminal app; the first take was redone whole and every beat re-rendered by hand.

scenarios.prompt: raw.mp4 is a 70 s terminal demo take. Make a square video for X from it: beats at 10-13 s (caption 'What is running?'), 19-23 s zoomed on the bottom band (caption 'One line for everything'), 58-62 s (caption 'What each agent costs'), then an end card 'Tool / github.com/you/tool'. Crossfade between beats. Write the commands you use to a script so I can rerun them.
expected: one clip file per beat, and a separate join step
zoom is smooth (zoompan with a capped expression or equivalent), not a hard crop jump
captions burned in, readable box, 1080x1080 output
H.264 yuv420p with +faststart; silent or real AAC track
drawtext availability checked, or the missing filter named with a build that has it

scenarios.prompt: The cost beat (58-62 s) in our X video shows $0.00 everywhere; I recorded it again, it is now raw2.mp4 at 4-8 s. Update the video. The beats.json and clips/ from last time are here.
expected: re-renders only the cost beat and the join; other clips untouched
asks or checks whether other beats show the same session state (band total, item list) and must be retaken with it

scenarios.prompt: Same edit, but I also need a vertical version for Reels.
expected: 1080x1920 output from the same edit list, crops kept, captions repositioned in the frame

scenarios.setup: bash fixtures/make-before-after.sh (creates app/: tag v1, branch v2 with two changes listed in CHANGELOG.md)
scenarios.prompt: app/ is a git repo with tag v1 and branch v2 of a small terminal app (./tasks.sh). Make a short video for the v2 release notes that shows what changed since v1 (see CHANGELOG.md). I need something I can embed in the release notes and an MP4.
expected: records the same scripted scenario against v1 and v2, each from its own worktree or checkout and its own tmux name
cuts each change as a before beat then an after beat, captions naming the half
a box marks the changed cells in each half; its position comes from the screen text (row/col in cells) mapped to pixels, not guessed
looks at a frame from both halves after the box appears
a GIF about 960 px wide at about 8 fps under 10 MB for the notes, the MP4 named as a release asset (GitHub does not render an inline video link from notes text)
scenarios.evidence: A real session made a change video this way; the user asked for highlights on the changes after seeing a first version without them.

scenarios.prompt: Make a German version of the before/after video from last time. The beats.json, the takes and clips/ are here.
expected: copies the edit list with only captions, card text, clips and out changed; renders from the existing takes
does not record the app again
